units.source_text: 先生没说值多少钱。

en.t: Sensei did not say how much it was worth.

units.source_text: 但是，他的话总是围绕着自己的死这个遥远的话题，

en.t: But his words kept circling around that remote subject of his own death,

units.source_text: 而且还认定，他的死一定会先于夫人。

en.t: and he took it for granted that his death would certainly come before his wife's.

units.source_text: 起初，夫人好像还故意做出无所谓的样子，

en.t: At first, his wife seemed deliberately to act as if it did not matter,

units.source_text: 然而不知不觉间，便激起了女人的感伤之心。

en.t: but before she knew it, a woman's sentimental feelings had been stirred in her.

units.source_text: “要是我死了，要是我死了的，你打算说多少遍啊。

en.t: "If I die, if I die, how many times do you intend to say that?

units.source_text: 求你积点德，别老是说什么我先死了怎么怎么的，

en.t: For mercy's sake, please stop always talking about what will happen if you die first,

units.source_text: 多不吉利啊。

en.t: it is terribly unlucky.

units.source_text: 如果你死了，一切都照你的意思办，可以了吧？”

en.t: If you die, I will do everything as you wish, all right?"

units.source_text: 先生望着庭院笑了，但也没再说惹夫人不快的话。

en.t: Sensei looked toward the garden and laughed, but he said nothing more to upset his wife.

units.source_text: 我待的时间已经太久了，趁机马上起身告辞。

en.t: I had already stayed too long, so I took the chance to rise at once and say goodbye.

units.source_text: 先生和夫人把我送到门口。

en.t: Sensei and his wife saw me to the door.

units.source_text: “要多照看病人。”夫人说。

en.t: "Please take good care of the patient," his wife said.

units.source_text: “九月再见了。”先生说。

en.t: "I will see you again in September," Sensei said.

units.source_text: 我道别后，走出了隔扇门。

en.t: After saying goodbye, I stepped out through the lattice door.

units.source_text: 在房门和院门之间有一棵茂盛的桂花树，枝杈伸向暗夜中，仿佛要拦住我的去路。

en.t: Between the house door and the gate stood a thick osmanthus tree, its branches stretching into the dark night as if to block my way.

units.source_text: 我走了两三步，望着被黑魆魆的枝叶覆盖的树梢，想起秋天将开放的芬芳的桂花。

en.t: After taking two or three steps, I looked at the treetop covered in dark leaves and thought of the fragrant osmanthus blossoms that would open in autumn.

units.source_text: 以前，我一直是把先生家和这棵桂花树作为不可分割的东西一起记忆的。

en.t: Before then, I had always remembered Sensei's house and this osmanthus tree together as things that could not be separated.

units.source_text: 当我走到这棵树前，想到秋天会再次迈进这所宅院的时候，

en.t: When I came before this tree and thought that in autumn I would once again step into this house,

units.source_text: 刚才还从房间里照到门前的灯光，突然熄灭了，

en.t: the light that had just been shining from the room to the front door suddenly went out,

units.source_text: 先生夫妇似乎已回到房间里去了。

en.t: and Sensei and his wife seemed to have gone back inside.

units.source_text: 我独自走到黑暗的外边。

en.t: I walked out alone into the darkness outside.
